mapper.insert: INSERT INTO salary_slip (employee_id, pay_month, file_path, uploaded_by) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{payMonth}, #{filePath}, #{uploadedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, pay_month FROM salary_slip WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY pay_month DESC
SELECT id AS slip_id, employee_id, pay_month, uploaded_by, uploaded_at FROM salary_slip ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
